chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, and others, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Ibn Abi Umeyr and Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the Qunut in the five (obligatory) prayers, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'Perform Qunut in all of them.' He said, 'And I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) after that about the Qunut, so he said to me: 'As for what you recite loudly, do not doubt (its validity).'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite Qunut loudly in the five daily prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith establishes the permissibility of reciting Qunut aloud in the five daily obligatory prayers, resolving potential doubts about whether loud recitation invalidates the prayer. It highlights the continuity of this practice from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to Imam al-Rida (AS), affirming its status as a recommended act within the Shia jurisprudential tradition.
